observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a stage with a plain white or grey cyclorama and a circular floor marking
observation.formation_and_space: group arranged in a semi-circle or scattered formation, moving around the stage space
observation.posture: stooped or hunched forward with bent knees, simulating elderly posture
observation.footwork: fast stomping and tapping steps in place or traveling, maintaining continuous rhythmic footwork on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms used to support weight on walking sticks or canes, holding ponchos or gesturing while leaning over
observation.hips_and_torso: torso is hunched forward throughout, with occasional shaking or trembling movements
observation.partnering: none; solo and synchronized group dancing without physical contact between dancers
observation.levels_jumps_turns: mostly low level due to stooped posture; occasional drops to the floor or falling onto backs
observation.costume_and_props: white pants and shirts, striped serapes or ponchos, straw hats with ribbons hanging down, dark boots, and wooden walking sticks or canes
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and weight transfer are obscured by camera angles, distance, and video resolution

signature_moments.what: dancers hunch forward holding walking sticks and rapidly stamp their feet in place while shifting weight
dancers collapse or fall backward onto the floor simultaneously
